name: vibebox
description: Universal local-first memory middleware where AI agents provide structured memory candidates and Core manages them.

interface.shortDescription: Local structured memory for AI coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Use VibeBox's local CLI and shared skill instructions to retrieve active guidance before coding, then capture the original userRequest with AI-agent structured memory candidates after work. VibeBox Core does not infer active memory from raw requests or summaries; it validates, stores, indexes, and renders the candidates supplied by the agent.
defaultPrompt: Capture this task with userRequest and structured candidates.
Audit VibeBox memory manually when debugging.
